name: cyberhuatuo
description: CyberHuaTuo Claude Code plugin marketplace: when an agent gets sick, let it ask HuaTuo, fix the error, and keep the cure.

plugins.name: cyberhuatuo-plugin
plugins.description: When a coding agent gets sick, CyberHuaTuo lets it diagnose the traceback through MCP, apply the cure, then save or upload the solved case as a reusable prescription with an optional First Soul Ring contribution path. A bundled PreToolUse guard also reviews destructive shell actions before execution.
